body.name: Restricted score-only reduced-experiment transfer handle
body.construction: A correctly scaled transfer attempt compares the reduced mean experiment \(\mathcal E_n^{\mathrm{mean}}\) only with the score-only limit that observes \(b\) exactly and observes \(X^{\mathrm{sc}}\sim N(h,\Gamma)\). It must construct Markov kernels in both directions whose deficiencies tend to zero uniformly on a specified dominated compact QMD submodel, and it must separately prove uniform integrability for the diameter losses before transferring expected risk. The previously proposed target with fixed Gaussian noise in the unscaled effect coordinates is excluded by the scaling obstruction. This handle asserts no equivalence: domination, product measurability, uniform likelihood-process approximation, and the expected-risk transfer remain proof obligations.
